rule: **Existing tools work.** Type checkers work through `.d.vibe.ts` (VIP-27), and linters, Knip, bundlers and test runners each read `.vibe`.
reason: A Bun plugin after VibeLang's sees ./dep.js where the .ts twin shows ./dep.ts. Bun's onResolve cannot pass a resolution on to later plugins, and the served module keeps the compiler's emitted names, so no resolver change reaches them.
